title.narrative: Provision of Lifesaving Health Services and Emergency Referrals for Conflict-Affected Populations in Old Kisrah Hospital, Deir-ez-Zor

description.narrative: ltpgtIn line with the “Life Saving Emergency Support in NES Deir-ez-Zor”, RA3 Third Reserve Allocation 2025 Strategy, International Medical Corps (IMC)* proposes critical health project to maintain referral system sustaining access to secondary and specialized health services at Old Al Kisrah National Hospital, the sole secondary referral facility in Al Kisrah district, serving over 350,000 in a remote and underserved area.ltbrgtThe project will focus on maintaining uninterrupted delivery of essential health services at Old Kisrah Hospital by ensuring continued operation of key departments including the Outpatient Department (internal medicine, pediatrics, dermatology, cardiology, and gynecology), Trauma and Surgical Unit, Laboratory, X-Ray unit, Neonatal and Neurology departments, Intensive Care Unit (ICU), and the basic burn unit established in 2023. This aligns directly with SHF's priorities of establishing fixed health points and maintaining referral systems for specialized care.ltbrgtIMC will provide a full support package encompassing salaries and incentives for medical and support staff, procurement and distribution of essential pharmaceuticals and medical supplies, provision of equipment and maintenance support, and coverage of operational and running costs such as fuel, cleaning materials, and stationery. In addition, IMC will deliver targeted training for hospital staff based on assessed needs and in coordination with hospital management.ltbrgtThroughout the 4-month intervention, IMC aims to support approximately 40,880 health consultations (11,773 men, 12,019 women, 4,579 boys, 12,509 girls) and facilitate 1,250 surgical procedures. By preserving access to life-saving health services, this project will mitigate preventable mortality and morbidity, particularly among women, children, and those with urgent trauma and surgical needs. ltbrgtThe proposed intervention is informed by the Health Cluster’s priorities and ongoing defunding risks identified under the allocation strategy. With its existing operational presence and technical expertise in the area, IMC is well-positioned to ensure rapid and accountable implementation, bridging the service gap created by the anticipated withdrawal of current support after June 2025. ltbrgt*International Medical Corps (IMC) is a US-registered independent affiliate organization of International Medical Corps (UK), IMC UK, ltbrgtwith which IMC UK shares the same name and charitable objectives and mission. IMC UK and IMC work together to deliver assistance ltbrgtprograms in an accountable and effective manner in pursuit of their commonly-held charitable objectives. IMC UK will engage IMC to ltbrgtimplement its programmes in the field, with IMC UK oversight, according to the terms and conditions of the agreement that results from ltbrgtthis proposal and the terms of the parties’ administrative service agreement. Together with IMC Croatia, IMC provides administrative and operational support to IMC UK and to the programmes on the ground, including but not limited to financial management, banking and cash management, procurement management/international procurements and logistics. ltbrgtlt/pgt
